name: Write plausible alternate history scenarios
description: Users asked for the creation of detailed, realistic, and plausible alternate history scenarios, often framed as documentary-style book chapters or news articles that avoid referencing the real-world timeline. The requests frequently involved complex geopolitical shifts, the restoration of specific empires, and significant divergences in East Asian or European history.
